q: Name the monomer used to make poly(ethene) and explain what happens to it.
Ethene. Its C=C bond opens and thousands of monomers join into a long chain (addition polymerisation).
Suggest one reason for the rise, and one problem it causes.
Plastics are cheap, light and easy to shape; but most are not biodegradable, so waste builds up in landfill and the oceans.
